hypothesis: Provisioning a NetworkManager keyfile connection offline from the D111 debug shell makes wlan0 auto-join the owner network at boot, and a polkit rule granting the wheel group NetworkManager control restores runtime network management over SSH; together these yield authenticated key-only SSH over the WLAN transport.
discriminator: Positive: after boot continuation, wlan0 holds an IPv4 address from the owner AP AND ssh as lmi to that WLAN address succeeds with SSH_CONNECTION showing the WLAN peer. Negative: no IPv4 on wlan0, association failure, or SSH over WLAN denied.
next_if_positive: Unplug USB and re-verify untethered SSH; run scripts/74 suite over WLAN as v1 evidence; record the WLAN transport milestone.
next_if_negative: Capture wpa_supplicant/NM logs and dmesg; if SAE is the failure, retry with a WPA2-only AP or hotspot; no further writes without a new receipt.

result.note: WLAN auto-connect provisioned offline; wlan0 got <lan-ip> via DHCP; key-only SSH over WLAN verified (SSH_CONNECTION peer <lan-ip>). scripts/74 passes 4/5 over WLAN; local-forward blocked by device-side AllowTcpForwarding no (r145 sshd_config gap).
